positions.name: ErasureDirectiveScope
positions.frame: What stock imperative formula commands the erasure or removal of specified knowledge, and how is its scope delimited?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: flat matter-of-fact imperatives using stock-phrase formulas ('Forget everything about' / 'Remove all knowledge of') to command irrealis erasure of concrete, named knowledge artifacts. The scope is set by enumerating specific targets — the fleet and its contracts in src-1, zeppelin routes in src-2 — with 'everything' and 'all' operating as totalizing scope-setters. Authority-ranking and informational power are performed identically across both: the speaker claims rank-based control over what the recipient may retain. No tension within the set; both are settled decision-register directives expecting compliance.
